evidence: Supplied manual API forms and authored offline integration tests; no native execution

sources.topic: CLR_POS_REG group-zero clearing and CLR_PORT_SIM mapped unsimulation
POS_REG_TYPE argument order, omitted group, representation codes 1/2/6/9 and axis-count meaning

implemented.inspection: POS_REG_TYPE reports stored representation without conversion; omitted second argument follows root caller group and defaults to 1 without source/robot context
implemented.clearing: CLR_POS_REG removes one group or all configured groups for zero; valid absent clear is idempotent; independent values and comments retained
implemented.unsimulation: CLR_PORT_SIM discards one configured logical-port simulation flag; later indirect input writes require simulation; values and comments retained
implemented.persistence: Existing typed context JSON preserves absence, remaining values/groups, comments and simulation flags
implemented.ownership: Exact disjoint INTEGER outputs; optional-middle argument mapping shared by emission and routine/handler effect analysis

portable_choices: POSITION and XYZWPR report zero axes where the manual leaves their count unspecified
XYZWPREXT reports its three stored extended slots, not discovered physical axes
JOINTPOS reports stored width even when register reads return a padded nine-slot copy
Register status 1 means absent; status 2 means invalid address/group; failed inspection preserves kind/axes
A clear of a valid absent position value succeeds and retains the register comment
Unsimulation retains last supplied value without hardware acquisition; an absent value remains absent
Root source/robot group selection uses the existing translator context; no additional controller default discovery
remaining: Native alarm/status mapping, physical group and external-axis discovery, controller I/O mode effects, strict mode and native acceptance
